dayHours.description: One day. null means closed. Times are 24h local time in the business timezone.

description: One file per business. Holds everything that differs between businesses: facts, services, hours, FAQs, and which tools are switched on. Validated in CI or by hand before a pack ships.

area.description: City and state, written the way a customer would say it.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/Chicago. All hours and bookings use this.

type.description: What kind of business: salon, clinic, cleaning service, and so on.

currency.description: ISO currency code for all prices in this pack.

notes.description: Anything the plain weekly grid cannot say, e.g. holiday closures.

channel.description: Where owner alerts and the evening summary go, e.g. telegram.

target.description: Channel-specific destination. Placeholder until the runtime phase sets the real value.

payment_notes.description: How customers pay, in the business's own words.

bookable.description: False for services the agent may describe but not book.

id.description: Stable slug. Bookings store this id.

tenant_id.description: Slug. Must match the pack file name (without .json) and the tenants.id row in Postgres.

tone_notes.description: How the assistant should sound for this business, in plain words.

tools.description: Tool switches. The engine registers exactly the tools set to true for a session. A tool that is off is not offered to the model at all.

title: Zeliks Engine config pack
